name: Facebook Community Sales OS - Social AIO Runtime
notes: Root cause confirmed from NHẬT KÝ API: get_list_fb_group_posts returns a top-level result array whose post item carries a cursor.
The previous cursor walker disabled generic cursor lookup inside arrays, so scan stopped after page 1.
Pagination now scans result arrays from the last item backward and allows the item's cursor to drive the next request.
Diagnostic evidence: page 1 returned 1 post + cursor; PAGE2 probe returned 3 posts, proving the API can paginate.
Full Group URL remains the supported input for vanity-slug groups; passing only hxx.gang was rejected by Social AIO in the live test.
